# Torquemade

> Torquemade is an independent, worldwide web and software studio operating in French and English, founded by Loan Rembeau. It builds custom websites and e-commerce storefronts, bespoke CRM systems, and real-time ERP-to-e-commerce inventory synchronization for legacy ERP and point-of-sale systems (examples: SAGE, Cegid, Odoo, Lightspeed). Primary markets are French-speaking Switzerland (Romandie), Belgium/Wallonia including Brussels, and Luxembourg, with a secondary focus on the US/English-speaking market. For a more detailed version of this file, see [/llms-full.txt](https://www.torquemade.com/llms-full.txt).

Site is bilingual: every URL below serves both French and English (language toggle on the page). No separate locale URLs.

## Services

- [Custom websites & e-commerce / Sites web sur mesure](https://www.torquemade.com/services/web-dev): Two build paths depending on the project: a custom-coded Next.js site for service businesses, studios, agencies, and brands, or a Shopify build for stores selling products online. Every site is built with SEO and GEO (AI-engine visibility) from the start, including semantic markup, an auto-generated sitemap, FAQ/Article schema, and an llms.txt file.
- [Custom CRM / CRM sur mesure](https://www.torquemade.com/services/crm): Software built around the client's actual workflow (bookings, quotes, dashboards, follow-up automation) instead of a generic schema retrofitted to fit. Delivered as a one-time investment the client owns outright (source code and database included), rather than a recurring per-seat subscription.
- [ERP to e-commerce stock sync / Synchronisation stock ERP ↔ site e-commerce](https://www.torquemade.com/services/erp-ecommerce): Connects an existing ERP or point-of-sale system (examples: SAGE, Cegid, Odoo, Lightspeed) to an online storefront through a custom real-time connector, so stock stays accurate across every sales channel. Where the existing software's API can't support reliable real-time sync, the alternative is a custom-built stock management tool connected natively from the start.

SEO and GEO (generative-engine optimization) content strategy is delivered as part of website projects rather than as a standalone service page; related articles are grouped under the SEO & Contenu category on the blog.

## Products

- [TankLogic](https://www.torquemade.com/tanklogic): A Torquemade sub-brand and inventory-sync software built specifically for mail-order live fish and coral retailers. See its own scoped file at [/tanklogic/llms.txt](https://www.torquemade.com/tanklogic/llms.txt) for product detail.
